#### Node version:

Run `nvm use` from within the project folder. Minimum required NodeJS version is >=16. You can also automatically invoke `nvm` when changing directories in order to always have a version required by project. For more info on shell integration visit [documentation](https://github.com/nvm-sh/nvm#deeper-shell-integration)

##### Environment variables:

Create `.env` file from `.env.example` template.

You can adjust Create-React-App development/production settings by setting environment variables: [Full list](https://create-react-app.dev/docs/advanced-configuration/)

It's useful to have `TSC_COMPILE_ON_ERROR` set to `true` in order to run and properly build TypeScript projects even if there are TypeScript type check errors.

You can also define environment variables that will be accessible from within the code, they need to be prefixed with `REACT_APP_` and you can read them in the code as `process.env.REACT_APP_VARIABLE_NAME`. [More info](https://create-react-app.dev/docs/adding-custom-environment-variables/)
